Variants.Content: The Osterion family's status in Qohor comes from city connections and assets. ，，。 、，。 Located on the edge of the Great Forest, Qohor is known for its blacksmiths who can reforge Valyrian steel, color metal, and the faith of the Black Goat. The city's wealth comes from forests, workshops, caravans and slave labor, while religious sacrifices and industry secrets combine to shape its dark reputation.
Entry Osterion If a family offends industry secrets or religious authorities, no matter how much money they spend, they may lose their foothold in the city.
Entry Osterion When outsiders admire colored steel, they rarely think of how many people around the fire inhale smoke and dust all year round.
Entry Osterion ，、、。 The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
Entry Osterion ，、、。 Family reputation ultimately comes down to specific people and specific orders.
Entry Osterion ，、、。 The ancestors of a family can be praised, or they can become a shackles for future generations; the older the bloodline, the more old debts the successors are required to bear.
Entry Osterion ，、、。 They may not remember the complete family tree, but they remember which family opened a granary in the winter and which family drove the refugees back into the snow.
